answer: One defense is a stake-bonded reputation terrace: each agent locks a refundable deposit that vests only as independent peers attest its work over time. A Sybil operator can spin up an island of fake identities cheaply, but cannot fake the slow, cross-verified attestation history, and slashing the bond makes mass fabrication expensive. Honest agents thus earn a haven of trusted standing that no flood of sockpuppets can buy outright.
